sections.content:
Compare how Hungarian expresses profession and roles:
- **Nominative**: *Tanár vagyok.* = I am a teacher. (Permanent identity/profession)
- **-ként**: *Tanárként dolgozom a nyelviskolában.* = I am working as a teacher. (Capacity, function, perspective)
- **-nak / -nek**: *Tanul orvosnak.* = Studying to be a doctor. / *Elmegy tanárnak.* = Going to work as a teacher.

sections.title: Expressing Roles in Comparison
rows: I am a doctor (statement of identity).
I help here in the capacity of a doctor.
I am studying to become a doctor.
He went to the countryside to work as a doctor.

items.spanish: Bár mérnök vagyok, a hétvégén önkéntesként segítek a táborban.
items.english: Although I am an engineer, on weekends I help as a volunteer at the camp.
